subject: Scope walkthrough: ISO 27001 & FedRAMP pre-audit scenarios
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire@redteam-audit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Pre-audit intake: scope clarifications and scenario questions

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for agreeing to the intake call next week. To make our time efficient, the audit team has a short set of pre-flight questions so we can lock the scope and clarify evidence expectations ahead of the walkthrough. Please see the items below — a quick bullet reply is fine, or upload the draft mapping if you have one.

Key items we need clarified:
- Service boundary: are you treating Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) as in-scope for FedRAMP Low, or will that be scoped separately?
- Encryption: KMS provider(s), key rotation cadence, where snapshots are stored (S3 vs customer vault).
- Multi-tenant/single-tenant isolation controls for Dedicated capacity pools and how control ownership shifts between hosted/dedicated/private modes.
- Evidence windows: log retention policy, snapshot cadence for enclave imaging, and how you produce immutable snapshots for auditors.
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have a completed SIG questionnaire draft we can reference for control mapping?

We attached our standard audit-intake-form (PDF) for your convenience. Can you also flag owners for each evidence ask and suggest an internal 30-minute slot for a scenario walkthrough?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Donovan
Senior Lead, RedTeam Audit Services
claire@redteam-audit.com

Attachment: audit-intake-form.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@redteam-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit intake: scope clarifications and scenario questions

Claire — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses below and a proposed plan. I attached a draft controls mapping that covers both ISO 27001 and FedRAMP alignment.

Short answers:
- Service boundary: Redwood Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated (reserved pools) will be in the primary FedRAMP Low scope. Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) will be treated as a separate deployment boundary — we'll provide a mapping showing how control responsibility is shared (customer vs Redwood) but it won't be in the initial Low boundary we're presenting. (Owner: Marissa)
- Encryption: We use AWS KMS for hosted and dedicated (multi-region primary keys + rotation every 90 days). For Private, customers may supply their KMS — we track that in the enrollment artifact. Snapshots are stored in customer-specific S3 buckets with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). (Owners: Karthik, Infrastructure)
- Isolation: Dedicated capacity runs on pinned GPU pools with network ACLs, hypervisor hardening, and tenant tagging. We'll provide the batch/job separation policy and runtime isolation diagram. (Owner: Olga)
- Evidence windows: Logs retained 365 days by default; critical security logs retained for 3 years (per contract). We can produce immutable S3 snapshots and a snapshot manifest for auditor extraction.
- SIG/CAIQ: We have a draft SIG intake; I attached a controls-mapping-draft.xlsx that crosswalks SIG/CAIQ to ISO/FedRAMP controls.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute scenario walkthrough this Wed 2026-12-01 10:00 PT (please confirm) — we'll have Marissa and Karthik on the call.
2) After the call, we'll upload the network diagram, encrypted snapshot manifest, and an evidence checklist to the Drive link below.
3) We'll commit to owners and dates in a short action list by end-of-day after the walkthrough.

Attachment: controls-mapping-draft.xlsx

Best,

Priyom Das
Manager, Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Claire Donovan <claire@redteam-audit.com>

Thanks Priyom — that helps a lot. Wed 2026-12-01 10:00 PT works for our team. Two quick asks before the walkthrough:

1) Can you upload a current network diagram (high-level) and a short note on snapshot immutability/process? We typically ask for a one-page summary so the technical reviewers can prepare.
2) Please confirm retention windows in a single line (you said 365 days / 3 years for critical logs — list which logs are considered critical).

I've attached our preflight-checklist; procurement at Mountain Bank (John Park) is copied because they'll want the evidence schedule for their internal gating.

Claire
